summary: Expand the citation to include JL 10.12.8–9.
rationale: The opening 'kətli arwono da=tloṯo=əšne, kal kalé b-i=qamaytaṯṯe' occurs in verse 8; the continuation 'w-ko-mḥalle ... w-ko-čiralle' occurs in verse 9. Both supplied consecutive verses are in the same stolen-cattle account. Keep verse 9 and include verse 8, rather than replacing 9 with the automatic best match.
